mapper.sql: id, product_name, product_code, description, base_profit_rate, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM products ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT FROM products WHERE 1=1
AND product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productName}, '%')
AND status = #{status}
ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products (product_name, product_code, description, base_profit_rate, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{productName}, #{productCode}, #{description}, #{baseProfitRate}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE products SET product_name = #{productName}, product_code = #{productCode}, description = #{description}, base_profit_rate = #{baseProfitRate}, status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
